description.value: BiBo Pizzeria is an authentic Italian restaurant located inside the McArthurGlen Designer Outlet in Richmond, operated by a team of Italian expatriates who have been serving Neapolitan pizza and housemade pasta since 2011. The restaurant sources high-quality ingredients directly from Italian farms and BC producers, including buffalo mozzarella DOP and Cortese Gavi di Gavi wine. It has earned recognition from Gambero Rosso, Italy's prestigious food and wine guide, and holds an Ospitalità Italiana certification.
